title: 4chan whistleblower: higher-ups think the visitors treat Earth like a zoo

tellings.quote: that they just don't care about us. Like, they just don't care. They don't care. It's more like a zoo where they're

plain: An anonymous poster on 4chan, an anonymous online message board, claimed to be a government insider and said that people high up believe the visitors simply do not care about humans and treat Earth like a zoo. The online video maker Chris Ramsay passes this on to Michels, quoting the poster: "they just don't care about us... It's more like a zoo." If true, it would mean whatever is here watches us without any real interest in our affairs.
